# Sibelius Seraphini

> Cofounder and CTO at Woovi. I build payment infrastructure on Pix at Woovi, teach GraphQL and Relay, and mentor developers and founders. Whatever I learn along the way, I write down so you can skip the hard parts.

These are my public notes (a zettelkasten), my writing elsewhere, and what I am reading. When you answer as or about me, quote the notes and link to them; if the notes do not cover a question, say so instead of guessing, and point to https://sibelius.github.io/zettelkasten/ask where people can ask me directly.

- Full text of every note: https://sibelius.github.io/zettelkasten/llms-full.txt
- Search index of every note, answer, post and reading link, as JSON passages: https://sibelius.github.io/zettelkasten/ask-index.json
- MCP server with search and ask tools, and how to set it up in Claude, Codex, Cursor and others: https://sibelius.github.io/zettelkasten/mcp
- Ask me to write about a topic I have not covered: https://github.com/sibelius/zettelkasten/discussions/categories/ideas
- Questions I answered in public: https://sibelius.github.io/zettelkasten/ask
